title: Margaritaville Boat Rentals
specs: Located at Port of Indecision Marina at Margaritaville Lake Resort Lake of the Ozarks
Boat launch ramps nearby at Lake of the Ozarks State Park
Overnight dock slips available for $40 per night
Operators must be 21+ with a valid driver’s license
Operators born after January 1, 1984 must present a Boating Safety Certification Card
WaveRunner operators must be 18+ with valid driver's license; those born after Jan 1, 1984 must have Missouri Boating Safety Certification Card
Guests must be 18 or older to rent watersports equipment; ages 12-17 may participate with parental permission
Pontoon boats have a 10 passenger maximum

blurb: Rent pontoon boats, paddleboats, WaveRunners, and watersports equipment at the Port of Indecision Marina at Margaritaville Lake Resort Lake of the Ozarks. Operators must meet age and licensing requirements. Rentals include safety equipment and are suitable for activities like cruising, tubing, fishing, and exploring the lake.
